definitions.explanation: The color of silver; a lustrous grayish-white metallic color.

examples.japanese: {銀色|ぎんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎた→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧。
⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{銀色|ぎんいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らしていた→照らす：04669_terasu⟧。
examples.english: The moonlight was shining silver on the lake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銀色|ぎんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}きだ→好き：02355_suki⟧。

notes:
{銀色|ぎんいろ} refers to the color silver—a metallic grayish-white color.

USAGE:
As a no-adjective, it modifies nouns with の:
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧: a silver car
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: silver hair
⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧ alone means "silver" (the metal). {銀色|ぎんいろ} specifically refers to the color. For metallic colors, Japanese typically uses ～⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ pattern: ⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧ → {金色|きんいろ}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to shine silver
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: to gleam silver
